premises.question: Does algebraic constraint decoding infer previously unavailable, economically useful Pathfinder facts, or merely restate graph parity/connectivity?
evidence: Main solver already uses parity, connectivity, per-mechanic bounds and BC1; existing offline CP-SAT/replay machinery supports exact labels.
Incidence parity Bx=e_g+e_t is sound as a relaxed walk invariant; its bridge consequences may be redundant.
Atlas identifies joint-feasibility and non-prefix search objects as gaps; evidence for a new consumer is not yet established.
alternatives: Static parity is entirely redundant; close incidence-only form.
Coupled regional capacity or obligation matching yields sound incremental contradictions.
A plan decoder yields useful complete-path structure but at prohibitive reconstruction cost.
premises.discriminator: Tiny exact parity/cut witnesses and a dated baseline novelty audit versus current prunes; only an independent decision-bearing advantage earns a subsequent treatment probe.

repositoryPriorArt.reason: Theorem classes, mechanism matrix, novelty gate and economics already owned.

Existing parent-family technique×variation discovery and independence methodology.
Historical prior-art census and cancelled frontier pilot already own H/V split, ZDD applicability and deferred interface gate; do not mistake them for a new lane.
Primary-source and multilingual 81-repo catalogue, distinguishing trail, F# bridge-lane, native graph propagator, C# DD and incremental SAT examples with explicit evidence grades.

phases.name: Soundness and underdetermination preflight
entry: Current main read; relevant exact/parity and probe owners identified.
outputs: Tiny tests and bounded real-level structural census
Cross-checked 81-repository multilingual source discovery catalogue and prior-census reconciliation

phases.name: Novel coupled constraint proof
entry: Stage-0 closed with explicit redundancy/novelty classification.
outputs: Smallest incremental witness or precise negative

phases.name: Witness-bound oracle shadow
entry: Stage-1 supported proof plus nonredundant case and opportunity.

phases.name: Conditional abstract-plan reconstruction
entry: Stage-2 identifies actionable reusable structure beyond runtime prune; otherwise skip with negative.
outputs: Bounded reconstruction and refinement result, or explicit refusal to build

phases.name: Conditional production capability
entry: Strong Stage-2/3 evidence and economics; queue grants treatment gate.
outputs: Narrowest opt-in consumer plus matched-work evidence or no treatment

phases.name: Splash-zone and hostile closeout
entry: Stage-0 evidence and any earned later phases are finished or explicitly closed.
outputs: Reconciled queue, docs, tooling and exact evidence dispositions
